# ast-tools-query — JavaScript examples

Bundled queries: `ast-tools-queries list --language javascript`.

## Find top-level JSDoc comments containing `@generated`

**Goal:** Find JavaScript files that have a top-level JSDoc block comment (`/** ... */`) containing
the `@generated` tag, and extract the tag text.

```bash
git ls-files -- '*.js' | \
  ast-tools-query javascript -f javascript-toplevel-jsdoc-comments.scm --format json | \
  bash <(ast-tools-queries show javascript-toplevel-jsdoc-comments-generated.sh)
```

**Output (snippet):**
```json
[
  { "file": "views/acm/Screen.js", "generated": "@generated by OraFormViewer" },
  { "file": "views/home/Screen.js", "generated": "@generated by TemplateWizard, v.2013/02/27" }
]
```

**Notes:**
- `javascript-toplevel-jsdoc-comments.scm` selects `comment` nodes that are direct children of
  `program` and start with `/**`; all captures named `comment` are iterated per file.
- `javascript-toplevel-jsdoc-comments-generated.sh` filters them by `@generated` and puts the text
  up to `//` or the end of the string into the `generated` field.
